description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer resize-integrity checkpoint: safe Rust owns traditional row-resize lifetime safety and preserves cursor presentation across both traditional and reflow screen-buffer resize paths.

entries.notes: ResizeIntegrityState routes wrap-disabled traditional shrinking through safely owned TextBuffer row storage. The direct witness reproduces Microsoft's one-row height shrink with attributed rows and completes successfully without aliased attribute-row lifetime state.

ResizeIntegrityState preserves CursorState presentation across both traditional and reflow resize strategies. The witness reproduces Microsoft's complete 2 x 5 x 5 strategy/dx/dy matrix and verifies cursor shape and size, while also proving the stronger full cursor state remains unchanged.
